data.general: Be cautious in your approach as Jupiter's influence in the 11th house may lead to overconfidence, which can hinder your progress. Focus on stability and take calculated risks. The Sun's transit in the 11th house also indicates a need for emotional balance.
data.luck: Your luck may fluctuate due to the conflicting influences of Mars in the 10th house and Rahu in the 6th house. Try to maintain a balance between your creative pursuits and professional responsibilities.
data.scope: This period may witness a surge in creative and intellectual pursuits, thanks to the Sun and Jupiter's presence in the 11th house. However, Saturn's transit in the 7th house indicates potential conflicts in relationships.
data.study: The Sun's transit in the 11th house can bring new opportunities for learning and growth. Focus on developing your analytical skills to make the most of this period.
data.love: Relationships may be put to the test due to the transit of Saturn in the 7th house. Communicate openly and honestly with your partner to resolve any conflicts.
data.travel: Mars' transit in the 10th house indicates a need for caution while traveling. Plan your trips carefully and stay focused on your goals.
